title: Story strip (ark and sea)
subject: Islamic Studies
source: Written for islamic-studies/y2 lesson 5 (Pupil PDF worksheet: story strip (ark and sea))
intro: Lesson 5: Prophet Nuh (عليه السلام): obeying Allah and patience. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

panels.title: Nuh calls his people
points: Nuh asked his people to worship Allah alone
Most of them refused and laughed
He kept calling for a very long time

timeline.text: Allah tells Nuh to build the ark
The flood; the believers and animals are saved

blocks.text: Draw the ark and the sea (no people). Write a sentence under each box.

keywords.def: a man chosen by Allah to bring His message
patience: staying calm and keeping going

questions.q: Retell the story of Nuh in three sentences.
questions.a: Nuh called people to Allah. They laughed. He built the ark and the believers were saved.

questions.q: On the pupil PDF story strip, draw the ark and the sea (no people) and write First, Next, Last sentences.
Extend: name two animals that went on the ark.
questions.a: For example: elephants, birds (pairs of animals)

questions.q: Stretch: when do you need to be patient like Nuh?
questions.a: For example: when learning something hard

questions.q: What did Nuh do when people laughed?
options: He stayed patient and kept going
questions.a: A) He stayed patient and kept going. Nuh showed sabr: he kept obeying Allah.

questions.q: Think again: would you keep doing right if people laughed?
